name: Lovable
summary: Build full-stack web apps by chatting with AI.
description: Lovable is an AI app builder that creates and edits full-stack web applications from natural-language prompts. Users iterate in a chat interface, connect a backend, and deploy without writing code by hand, which makes it popular with founders and non-developers prototyping products. It offers a free plan to get started and paid plans with more messages and collaboration features.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: It offers a free plan to get started and paid plans with more messages and collaboration features.

howToUse.title: Create an account
howToUse.description: The docs say you can start for free with email, Google, GitHub, or Apple.

howToUse.title: Describe what you want
howToUse.description: The homepage says to describe the product in plain language. The docs say Lovable generates a working application, including frontend, backend, database, authentication, and integrations.

howToUse.title: Review and iterate
howToUse.description: The homepage says to refine the design, then ship it. The docs say to review the app and iterate.

howToUse.title: Publish, then sync the code
howToUse.description: The docs say to publish to a live URL, and, when you want the code in your own pipeline, sync it to GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.
